mapper.sql: id, resource_type, release_id, service_name, provider_id, desired_state, observed_state, owner_node, last_success_at, last_error
mapper.insert: insert into ai_registry_projection ( id, resource_type, release_id, service_name, provider_id, desired_state, observed_state, owner_node, last_success_at, last_error) values (#{id}, #{resourceType}, #{releaseId}, #{serviceName}, #{providerId}, #{desiredState}, #{observedState}, null, case when #{observedState} = 'READY' then now() else null end, #{error,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) on conflict (resource_type, release_id, provider_id) do update set service_name = excluded.service_name, desired_state = excluded.desired_state, observed_state = excluded.observed_state, last_success_at = case when excluded.observed_state = 'READY' then now() else ai_registry_projection.last_success_at end, last_error = excluded.last_error
mapper.select: select from ai_registry_projection order by resource_type, service_name
select from ai_registry_projection where resource_type = #{resourceType} and release_id = #{releaseId} order by last_success_at desc nulls last limit 1
